Questions hosts actually ask

What happens after the 3 days?

You pick a plan — or walk away. No card up front, so there's nothing to cancel and no surprise charge.

What if she doesn't know the answer?

She says so, and pings you. iris never guesses — an "I'll check with your host" beats a wrong answer.

Will Turo ban this?

iris drafts and sends through your existing flow, with you in control — like a human co-host typing on your behalf.

What about angry guests?

De-escalation is her best subject: fast acknowledgment, real information, no promises she can't keep. Hard cases get flagged to you immediately.

Does she speak Spanish?

Sí. Portuguese too. Your guest texts in any language; iris answers in kind.

What do you do with my data?

Your fleet data answers your guests. Period. We don't sell it, share it, or train public models on it.
